checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.empty: No items selected for this order

payment.holdHint: The amount is reserved. Once the order is confirmed, the money goes to the seller's settlement account. Fee: 0 UZS.

summary.holdNote: The amount is reserved. Once the order is confirmed, the money goes to the seller's settlement account. If the seller declines, it is returned the same way.
summary.legal: By placing the order you accept the 1mart offer and consent to personal data processing

antifraud.title: Confirm the operation
antifraud.lead: Confirm that you are carrying out this operation personally, without the involvement or instructions of fraudsters.
antifraud.point1: 1mart and bank staff never ask for SMS codes or card details.
antifraud.point2: Do not continue if someone rushes, threatens you or asks to move money to a “safe account”.
antifraud.point3: Check the amount and recipient before confirming.
antifraud.checkbox: I am carrying out this operation myself, without instructions from third parties

otp.title: SMS code
otp.text: We sent a 6-character code to {phone}. It is valid for 59 seconds.
otp.expired: The code has expired. Request a new one.
otp.failed: Could not verify the code. Please try again.
otp.lockedText: The code was entered incorrectly three times. Financial operations are temporarily unavailable for your security.

funds.title: Insufficient funds
funds.cardText: The bank declined the payment: insufficient funds on the card. Choose another payment method.
funds.balanceText: The company balance is too low. Top it up by transfer from your settlement account or pay with a corporate card.

stock.title: Out of stock
stock.text: These items ran out at the seller while you were checking out. Remove them to pay for the rest.

addCard.title: New corporate card
addCard.note: Only cards issued to a company: UzCard, Humo, Visa, Mastercard. We store only the first 6 and last 4 digits.
addCard.errorCorporate: This is a personal card. 1mart accepts corporate cards only

error.title: Payment failed
error.text: No money was charged. Check your connection and try again.

success.title: Order placed
success.text: The funds are reserved and the order has been sent to the seller. Once confirmed, the money goes to the seller's settlement account.

created.title: Order accepted
created.text: The seller will confirm the order

paid.title: Order paid
paid.text: The seller will confirm the order

processing.title: Order is being processed
processing.text: The seller is preparing the order

awaitingSeller.title: Awaiting seller confirmation
awaitingSeller.text: Funds are reserved and will be charged as soon as the seller confirms the order.

confirmed.title: Order confirmed
confirmed.text: Payment charged, the order is being processed. Expected delivery — {date}

handedToDelivery.title: Handed to delivery
handedToDelivery.text: The courier service is delivering your order. Expected delivery — {date}
handedToDelivery.textNoDate: The delivery service will confirm the date

readyForPickup.title: Ready for pickup
readyForPickup.text: Your order is waiting at the 1mart pickup point

delivered.title: Order delivered
delivered.text: Delivered {at}. Rate the purchase or request a return

rejectedBySeller.title: Canceled by seller
rejectedBySeller.text: The seller could not fulfil the order. The reserved funds have been returned

returnRequested.title: Return requested
returnRequested.text: Return request accepted {at}. The seller will review it; money goes back to the same payment method

orders.cancelConfirmText: You can cancel until the seller confirms. The reservation is released and money returns to the same payment method.
orders.reviewDone: Thank you! Your review has been sent
orders.rejectedToast: The seller declined the order. Funds returned

return.title: Request a return
return.note: The seller will review the request. Money goes back to the method you paid with.

cart.paymentTitle: Pay from company balance or with a corporate card
cart.deliveryNote: Express 24, Maxsus Courier, Yandex Delivery or a pickup point

pdp.title: Payment methods
pdp.hint: The amount is reserved and goes to the seller's settlement account once the order is confirmed
pdp.buyBoxHint: Pay from company balance or with a corporate card
pdp.balanceNote: Topped up by transfer from the company's settlement account

balance.title: Company balance
balance.createError: Could not save. Please try again.
balance.topUpHint: We'll issue an invoice with 1mart's bank details. Transfer the money from your company account and it appears on the balance once received.
